label: Australia Cup LMS
rules: LAST MAN STANDING RULES The aim of the game is to choose a winner from each round of the competition All tips must be unique for every round until the final - you cannot repeat a team unless you have survived until the final. At any stage before the final if you have previously selected all remaining teams in the competition, you will be eliminated If all remaining players are eliminated together before the final round, all teams will move on to the next round. Once you get a prediction incorrect you are eliminated. If a tip is not entered before deadline, a random pick will be chosen via wheel spinner on discord Once the tournament reaches the final round, all remaining players are free to pick any of the final teams, however will also need to answer the following tie-breaker questions to determine a winner. - First Goalscorer - Minute of First goal You must pick at least 1 NPL team in either Phase 1 or Phase 2 of the Round of 32. AUSTRALIA CUP LMS FORMAT ROUND OF 32 - 2 PHASES - MUST TIP IN BOTH PHASES. Phase 1 - 22/7 - 27/7 Phase 2 - 29/7-30/7 ROUND OF 16 QUARTER FINALS SEMI FINALS FINAL
